title: Svenska Kraftnät NUP — conditional connection agreement (villkorad anslutningsavtal) mechanism
description: One record per published mechanism / rule that allows transmission-grid connections to be granted earlier than the underlying grid reinforcement timeline. Per NUP §4.4.2. The mechanism is a temporary measure ('tillfällig åtgärd') — the connecting party accepts conditions including curtailment ('nedstyrning') under specified operating conditions in exchange for an earlier in-service date. For the cell-feasibility model, this mechanism relaxes the buildability gate: a node where the queue is closed against firm capacity may still be 'open' for actors willing to accept conditional terms.

applicability_period_start_year.description: First year the mechanism is applicable to new connections.

applicability_period_end_year.description: Last year of applicability for the priority window. Source uses 'närtid (2026-2030)'.

scope.description: Geographic scope at which the mechanism is granted. National per §4.4.2 — applies wherever Svenska Kraftnät identifies suitable opportunities.

implementation_phase.description: Where the mechanism stands in deployment. Per §4.4.2 source: starts with limited scope ('begränsad omfattning'), evaluated for broader implementation later.

selection_criteria.description: Criteria the source explicitly states for selecting which queue applicants get a conditional agreement.

stated_constraints.description: Constraints / conditions on the connecting party that the source explicitly states.

expected_in_service_acceleration_years.description: Source states the mechanism should bring in-service date forward by at least this many years to be relevant for selection.
